study.title: Effects of electroacupuncture combined with flurbiprofen axetil on postoperative pain and early functional recovery after breast cancer surgery
study.comparator_class: Superficial nonacupoint needling with inactive stimulator; both receive flurbiprofen axetil
study.independence: Distinct from He hepatectomy article by first-page identity, operation and setting; no linked cohort identified.
study.identity_notes: First page labels Case Control Study, footnote STROBE; methods describe prospective computer block randomized trial. Accept randomized description provisionally; clarify editorial/design inconsistency.
